prepared_for: Raymond Ayac and the Nado's Jewellery team
title: A launch *worth the journey.*
subtitle: A guest programme for Nado's Meet Her launch at Forever Is Now, Giza, November 2026: international press, clients and creators, hosted by NOYA.

blocks.label: The idea
blocks.title: Bring the right people to Giza.

blocks.text: Nado's launches Meet Her at the sixth Forever Is Now, at the Pyramids of Giza from 4 to 28 November, the first edition led primarily by women artists. The launch will be seen by those in the room. NOYA hosts the people who carry it further: international press, top clients and creators.
A collection called Meet Her, launched where women artists lead the conversation.

rows: The sixth Forever Is Now runs from 4 to 28 November 2026 at the Pyramids of Giza.
It is the first edition led primarily by women artists.
Meet Her is listed in Art D'Égypte's programme for this edition.

items.title: The press days
items.text: International and regional press hosted for the launch: arrivals, stays, a visit to the exhibition within Art D'Égypte's programme, and a private lunch.

items.title: The client evening
items.text: Nado's closest clients hosted for an evening at the exhibition, followed by a private dinner nearby.

items.title: The creator stay
items.text: A small group of creators hosted over two days: the exhibition, the Grand Egyptian Museum and content timed to the launch.

blocks.text: Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.

left.title: Nado's leads
items: The collection and the brand story

right.title: NOYA delivers in Egypt
items: VIP guest hosting: arrivals, hotels, chauffeurs

items.text: VIP airport reception, private transfers and check-in. A welcome dinner.
The launch at Forever Is Now, then the client evening.
The Grand Egyptian Museum for content, then departures.

blocks.text: Every guest has one NOYA host, from the airport to the last transfer. Nado's team stays with the collection and the launch.

items.title: Choose the guests
items.text: One call this month to agree who to host, and for how many days.

items.title: NOYA returns a costed programme
items.text: Hotels, transfers, dinners and hosting, with a clear budget.

items.title: Holds
items.text: NOYA holds rooms and venues as soon as you approve.
